verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm selling legal services, so running the product headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. Its client-facing tools (trademark extranet, AI brief-analysis interface, dashboards) are interactive interfaces. Nothing shows a CLI, API, or CI mode, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
